title: Autonomous Drone Crop Pathology Detector
description: An edge AI robotics platform deploying deep learning models on embedded drones to detect powdery mildew in vineyards.
problemStatement: Manual vineyard inspection takes 4-6 days per hectare, leading to late blight detection and crop destruction.
targetUsers: Vineyard managers, precision agronomists, and crop inspectors
technologies: Python, YOLOv8-Nano, OpenCV, PyTorch, Raspberry Pi 4, FastAPI
primaryRisk: Edge CPU inference latency (>2,500ms) will drop frames below real-time operational thresholds.
fixes: Export model weights to ONNX / TensorRT with INT8 quantization for sub-60ms edge inference.
Implement automated unit testing for ML pipeline preprocessing steps.
Set up cross-validation splits stratified by category to prevent data leakage.
